title: Uka jan jaytjasir Autoridad
intro: Nayra markanakanjja, mä chʼamani autoridadaw nayrajj apnaqäna, walja yänaksa ukat jan jaktʼkay jaqenakan jakäwipsa apnaqarakïnwa. Qhana chimpunakas ukat iwxt’awinakas utjkchïnxa, uka apnaqirix jan yäqañ thakhi ajlliwayi, ukat mä jach’a ch’axwawiruw puriyi, ukax pachan pachaparuw ist’asiraki.
clues: Nayajj mä jachʼa dominion qhep qhepa chʼamanïtwa ukat autoridadanïtwa sasaw sista.
Taqi markan Tatitupan khitata alt’at chuyman yatiyiriruw ch’axwawaytxa.
Markanakajajj jachʼa utanakan sum yatitapatwa uñtʼatäpjjäna, ukat uka jawirajj jiwasan civilización jiwasatak chʼamañchtʼäna.
Walja milagronak uñjirïtwa, mä thujrujj katariruw tukuwayjjäna ukat mä amparajj kʼajkir qhantʼarakïna.
Diosan kamachipäkchïnsa, esclavot mä tama jaqenakarojj janiw oraqjat sarjjapjjañap munkayätti.
Sarxir jaqinakar arknaqatajax nayarusa, ejercitonakajarus mä t’aqa quta chuymaruw puriyapxitu.

arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
